impact.text: Any user who enables transfers (a core token functionality) immediately exposes their entire vault balance to theft by **any attacker**

precondition_sources.text: The victim user holds a balance of shares in the WERC7575Vault.
The victim user has set a self-allowance allowance[user][user] on the ShareToken sufficient for the withdrawal.
The attacker is neither the owner of the shares nor an authorized operator of the victim.

intent_sources.text: A vault withdrawal or redemption against an owner's shares should only succeed when the caller is that owner or an authorized operator of that owner.
A user's self-allowance on the ShareToken should not by itself authorize a third party to withdraw or redeem that user's vault funds.
